page_title: HOL 0-3 MAI | Holstein Kiel v Mainz 24/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Sascha Stegemann has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Mainz are ruled offside.
90+3' Marvin Schulz (Holstein Kiel) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
90+1' Mainz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+1' Substitution. Dominik Kohr is replaced by Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz).
90+1' Bo Henriksen prepares a substitution. Phillipp Mwene is replaced by Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz).

90+1' A sweet pass finds Paul Nebel (Mainz) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the top left corner. Timon Weiner is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The ball goes out of play. Mainz are awarded a corner kick.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The ball possession is 40:60. The current number of corner kicks is 2:5.
85' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
85' Paul Nebel (Mainz) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
84' Paul Nebel (Mainz) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
83' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
80' Bo Henriksen decides to make a substitution. Jonathan Burkardt will be replaced by Armindo Sieb (Mainz).
80' Substitution. Silvan Widmer (Mainz) in, Anthony Caci out.
79' The attendance is 14500.
79' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
78' The total number of attempts is 7:16. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:6.

77' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dominik Javorcek (Holstein Kiel) comes onto the pitch so that Steven Skrzybski can be given a rest.
75' Anthony Caci (Mainz) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
72' Marcel Rapp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marvin Schulz (Holstein Kiel) replacing Max Geschwill.
71' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Mainz.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jae-Sung Lee trots off the pitch and is replaced by Hyun-Seok Hong (Mainz).
68' The referee awards a corner and Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) goes over to take it.
67' Timon Weiner pulls off a great save to deny Phillipp Mwene (Mainz), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.

66' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Robin Zentner pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
65' Timo Becker (Holstein Kiel) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
62' Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
61' Marko Ivezic (Holstein Kiel) brings his opponent down. Sascha Stegemann has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Mainz.
58' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) takes a mid-range free kick and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.

57' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the bottom of the right post is denied by a decent save from Timon Weiner.
56' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
56' Patrick Erras (Holstein Kiel) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
55' Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul.

53' 0 - 3 The ball hits the back of the net! Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) meets a brilliant cross from Anthony Caci and scores with a cracking header from near the penalty spot in off the bottom of the left post. Timon Weiner had no chance of stopping that. The score is 0:3.
52' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
51' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
50' Paul Nebel (Mainz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
49' Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
48' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
47' Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and the ball is aimed to low to the middle, but Robin Zentner is alert and thwarts the effort.
46' Substitution. Lewis Holtby will be replaced by Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Paul Nebel (Mainz) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

45' Paul Nebel (Mainz) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Timon Weiner anticipates well and smothers the ball. Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
44' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
43' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
43' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
41' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Robin Zentner.
41' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Sascha Stegemann stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
39' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner which is cleared.
39' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
37' 0 - 2 Goal! Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Timon Weiner into the bottom right corner.
37' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) is going to take the penalty!
36' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
36' There's a break in play and referee Sascha Stegemann must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Mainz using VAR. This could be interesting!
34' Surely that's handball by one of the Holstein Kiel players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
33' Here is a change. Tymoteusz Puchacz is going off and Marcel Rapp gives the last tactical orders to Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel).
33' Shuto Machino will be replaced by Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel).
32' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) fires the ball from the free kick and it smashes against the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
32' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position, just outside the box.
32' A player from Holstein Kiel takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Mainz are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
31' The ball is cleared after Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
25' A pass from Danny da Costa (Mainz) is intercepted by Timon Weiner and the move breaks down.
23' Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just over the bar.
23' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) prepares to take a corner kick.

22' Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Holstein Kiel are going to take it.
21' Holstein Kiel take a short corner kick.

20' Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Holstein Kiel will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
16' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Mainz force a corner. They send men into the box.
15' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a shot towards the bottom left corner from distance, but Timon Weiner hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.
14' The Mainz players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

11' 0 - 1 Goal! Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Timon Weiner had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:1.
8' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
8' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Mainz will have a corner.
6' Holstein Kiel are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
4' What a miskick by Kaishu Sano (Mainz). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
3' CHANCE! Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Holstein Kiel will have the kick-off.
Sascha Stegemann is introduced as the referee for today's match.
